'''Bynin''' was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] present at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] during the [[Great Galactic War]], immediately before the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]] [[Sacking of Coruscant|attack]]. He, alongside [[Alara]], [[Kursil]], [[Ceras]] and others, was one of the many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to fall during the battle.
